scope.kimi_mla: Real B200 component with official dimensions, fixed random BF16 weights, not a full Kimi checkpoint.
scope.kimi_moe: Random BF16 active-expert proxy: 896-way router, only routed experts 0..15 plus two shared experts instantiated; expert IDs retained.
scope.mamba_precision: Official Nemotron Mamba shape/formula with fixed random BF16 weights/inputs; FP32 recurrence and varied persistent-state formats. Historical MX8 is explicitly block128, not current PLENA MX8 block8.
scope.nemotron_traffic_gap: Offline attribution of an already captured real-checkpoint NVFP4 S128 Mamba NCU report; no new full-model timing.

sanitization_policy.original_checksum_files_renamed: SOURCE_SHA256SUMS.txt; root SHA256SUMS is regenerated for published bytes
sanitization_policy.opaque_binary_limit: Known credential-literal byte patterns scanned; reports not semantically decoded. Original raw profiler data retained.

added_files.reason: Publication exporter, not original GPU capture code

files.renamed_reason: Preserve original checksum evidence; new root SHA256SUMS verifies published bytes.
